watches.name: New York Solar
watches.description: Celebrate New York’s historic championship with the New York Solar, a limited-edition VIANI Timepiece created to mark a time the city will forever remember. Featuring a vivid NY blue dial with orange accents, paired with a stainless steel bracelet, this edition brings a bold presence to the VIANI Solar collection and feels celebratory without losing its everyday wearability. Powered by light energy , the New York Solar runs on both indoor and outdoor light, capturing the electricity of the city straight to your wrist. Produced in a small batch with limited quantities. Production will ship within 3-4 months guaranteed.

watches.name: VIANI SONA
watches.description: The VIANI SONA returns for its third edition, this time in 18k White Gold EP. Drawing from the 70s disco scene and the era’s design language - defined by slim, unisex proportions and a polished white-gold finish that dances with the light. Featuring an evolved recessed matte white dial adorned with Hindi numerals hand-drawn by our skilled calligrapher and printed in lacquer, complemented by a black alligator-embossed leather strap , with options available in an 18k While Gold EP bracelet. Swiss-made and assembled Limited to just 20 numbered pieces per model, individually numbered and engraved on the back casing
